summary: Nepal's NDC combines conservation, restoration, agriculture and water measures. Conservation pledges include 46% forest cover overall and 45% by 2030; sustainable management of 50% of Tarai/Inner Tarai forests and 25% of middle-hill/mountain forests by 2030; and community management of 60% of forests with 50% women's representation by 2035. Restoration targets 168 m3/ha growing stock by 2030. Agricultural targets include 5,000 ha of orchards by 2030 and 10,000 ha by 2035, soil organic matter of 3.95% by 2030 and at least 4% by 2035, 5,000 ha/year agroforestry, and 200 climate-resilient farms by 2030 rising to 500 by 2035. The map shows forest at 48.3% (71,543 km²) and agriculture at 27.5% (40,742 km²); each 5,000-ha orchard or annual agroforestry commitment is about 0.12% of agricultural area. Mixed water targets include a 50% increase in sub-watershed availability, 50% wetland restoration and 80% population benefit from spring protection.
